name: honcho
description: Connect Honcho to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Honcho MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Honcho to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with your memory across AI tools using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Honcho workspace.
Find anything in Honcho that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review your memory across AI tools in Honcho.
